title: Time class missing fold parameter in constructor
rationale: The Time class constructor does not accept the fold parameter, so when creating a Time item from a time object with fold=1, the fold is not passed to the underlying time object, resulting in fold=0.

def __new__(
        cls,
        hour: int,
        minute: int,
        second: int,
        microsecond: int,
        tzinfo: tzinfo | None,
        trivia: Trivia | None = None,
        raw: str = "",
    ) -> Time:
        return time.__new__(cls, hour, minute, second, microsecond, tzinfo)
